opening.argument: The purported tech-support worker greets callers by asking how he may “screw up” a PC, make it blue-screen, or infect it with viruses. Those deliberately incompetent offers, alongside the description’s invitation to “let the failure ensue,” frame the Microsoft Sam support job as a humorous fictional failure, not a functioning service. The supervisor’s instruction to hide the team’s inability to solve problems belongs to that absurd dialogue. Nothing in the supplied material pairs it with a payment request, a credential request, an external destination, or an observable real-world support transaction.

citations.quote: How may we screw up your PC today?
How may we make your PC blue screen today?
How may we infect your computer with viruses and all that crap?
And make sure you do not tell anyone that we don't know how to solve their problems!
